title: 第7章 遗留物
novel_title: 手握旧日权柄，弹幕硬说我是主角(灰烬暗燃)
content_zh: 刚才，面具人醒来发现自已正躺在绿化带里，他不用想都知道是谁救了自已。无意间把别人卷入进来，没想到人家反倒成了他活下来的关键因素。这让他既惭愧又感激，觉得脸都要丢光了。所以他醒来后立刻返回楼上401室，拿上自已的背包，循着打斗的痕迹一路追了过来。面具人一个急刹停在许牧面前，看了一眼狼狈的许牧，他不好意思地扯了一下帽檐道：“大意了大意了，没想到这个失控者这么强，抱歉抱歉。”旋即，他露在外面的眼睛突然睁大，指着许牧的左手，脱口道：“我去！怎么把自已搞成这样？”在面具人的理解里，许牧能抗下那声让自已昏迷的尖啸，并救自已出来，还能和怪物女孩一对一单挑，从幸福小区激战到这里，认为许牧的实力应该不逊色于自已，再不济也不至于断手断脚。你还好意思问，我现在能完整……不对，能活着站在这里就很不错了……许牧白了面具人一眼，带着强忍剧痛的颤音，没好气道：“闲话少说，赶紧用你的超凡物品解除这片空间……”“还不行，如果现在解除这片空间，李桃，也就是那个女孩将以怪物的状态出现在现实。”面具人卸下肩上的背包，扯开拉链，“而且你也会把断手的状态带回现实。”“先把伤口处理一下。”他从背包里拿出一瓶暗红色液体，递给许牧，“把这个倒在伤口上，可以快速止血，然后我们去解决李桃。”许牧接过那个瓶子，脸色苍白道：“李桃被我的能力影响，她现在没有攻击和杀戮的欲望，出现在现实不会伤害到任何人，完全可以让749局处理。”当然，这一定会引起恐慌，至于怎么平息恐慌和封锁消息，就是749的事了……许牧在心里默默补充道。“但这样，她的超凡遗留物就会被749局收走。”面具人重新背上背包，看向许牧，“李桃身体里的特殊，可以让你的左手复原，你确定要放弃这个机会？”“超凡遗留物？那是什么？”由于身体虚弱，精神涣散，许牧一个愣神间，心里话语脱口而出。面具人眼眸诧异，随即明悟道：“你竟然不知道这个？刚成为超凡者没多久吧。”许牧不语，有些懊恼自已不小心暴露了虚实。“超凡生物死亡后，他们的超凡灵性会逐渐凝聚在一起，形成遗留物。”面具人自顾自解释道，“这些遗留物可以用来调配魔药，制作符咒或者超凡物品。”然后他话锋一转，彰显自已学识般说道：“但这不是绝对的，有的时候，超凡灵性不会凝聚，而是逸散，没有特殊手段无法收集。”许牧伫立在一旁平静听着，同时也想清楚了一些细节。原来，陆剑星他们当时在殡仪馆查看监控，其中一个重要目的就是为了寻找安琳的超凡遗留物。只不过那些超凡灵性被我吸收了，让陆剑星和风华瑾误以为它们逸散掉了。怪不得他们当时的表情有点失望。等等！面具人的目标是杀死李桃，获取超凡遗留物，那安琳的死亡会不会也是他的手笔？想到这里，许牧斟酌问道：“你最近一直在狩猎这些被污染的失控者？”面具人毫不避讳，坦然答道：“没错，两天前刚解决了一个，同样是女性，同样诡异的肚子，同样是肖凡的粉丝，她叫安琳。我收走了安琳的超凡遗留物，发现那属于‘生命序列’，有强大的再生能力。所以我敢断定，李桃也属于这个序列，因此你的手还有救。”闻言，许牧眉头一皱。这对不上呀，如果你收走了安琳的超凡遗留物，那她怎么还有多余的超凡灵性供我吸收？而且安琳的超凡灵性明明是‘精神序列’。豁然之间，许牧想到一种可能。那就是安琳死亡后，成为尸体的她再次被某种因素污染上了‘精神序列’的超凡灵性。“那你如何确定李桃死亡后，她的超凡灵性一定会凝聚，万一是逸散……”许牧抬起血淋淋的半只左手，“你有办法收集她的超凡灵性，帮助我恢复左手？”“没有。”面具人如实回答。“如果出现那种情况，事后我会向我的组织申请使用安琳的超凡遗留物。”他抬手扶了下面具，斟酌道，“但那需要时间，到时你的手能恢复到什么程度，我不敢保证。”果然还是不太靠谱啊……许牧腹诽了一句，但现在他也确实没有别的办法来治疗左手的伤势。许牧暗中叹气，妥协道：“行吧，但是提前说好，我不善杀伐，等会由你负责解决李桃。”面具人抬手做了个ok的手势，不甚在意道：“没问题。”说完，他伸出大拇指和食指，做出手枪的动作，指向旁边一辆皮卡车。水枪！他指尖水雾凝结，一道纤细锋利的高压水柱激射出去，穿透了皮卡车门，破坏了门锁。面具人拉开车门，率先坐上驾驶位。他以接线的方式启动车辆，扭头对许牧说道：“上车！”靠！有这能力最开始时你倒是一枪秒了李桃啊，现在拿出来装逼，真想给你两拳……许牧暗暗吐槽一句，坐上副驾位置，还没等拉上车门，车辆轰然启动，瞬间加速窜了出去。十几分钟后，青藤市最大的露天体育场门前，皮卡车一个漂移刹停。面具人和许牧同时推开车门走了下来。体育场上空，颜色各异的激光灯柱跟着音乐节奏巡回移动照耀。场内人声喧闹，尖叫呐喊声此起彼伏。几个身穿制服的安保人员守在体育场入口前。“这里应该就是李桃潜意识具现出的演唱会。”面具人目光扫过体育场上空的灯光道。潜意识空间还是真方便……许牧啧啧称奇，他只是随意指了一个方向，李桃就自已以合理的方式具现出了场景和人员。面具人径直往入口处走去，许牧紧随其后，而那些安保人员视若无物，没有任何阻拦。“这些人都是李桃潜意识具现出来的，只能和李桃交互，不用管他们。”面具人随口解释道。两人步入前厅，上到六楼，穿过一条通道，来到体育场内的最上层看台上。下方足球场中心被搭建出一个临时舞台，舞台中央，一个人影正在跳着不怎么好看的舞蹈。许牧猜测那个人应该就是肖凡，只可惜是李桃具现出来的，否则他真想怂恿面具人过去弄死他。视线收回，许牧打算从观众席中寻找李桃的身影，可他接下来看到的景象让他倒吸了一口凉气。阶梯看台坐了近千人，无一例外全是女性，她们的肚子全部高高隆起，乳白触手从里面根根钻出，蠕动翻滚着爬满了整个观众席。那些粉丝癫狂呐喊，表情扭曲，撕扯着自已的头发，抓挠自已的脸皮，有的抽出自已肚子上的触手，疯狂甩动。许牧倒退一步，深深吸了一口气。如果这个场景是李桃根据现实经历具现出来的，那就说明在现实中，还有近千名被污染的女孩隐藏在青藤市里。如果她们同时爆发，那后果……肖凡想要干什么？“我看到她了，按照约定，我去处理，你在这等会儿。”面具人拍了拍许牧的肩膀道。许牧收起思绪，点了点头，提醒道：“她虽受我能力影响不会反击，但也不易死亡，再加上她是‘生命序列’，生命力会更顽强，你得卖点力气，尽量多的累加伤害，等我的能力效果结束，这些伤害足够让她瞬间暴毙。”“你这能力还挺有趣的。”面具人诙谐一笑，然后屈膝弓背，向斜下方的看台跳去。他来到李桃十几米外的位置，抬手射出两发水枪，水柱穿过脑袋，心脏，打得李桃摇晃了两步。伤口快速愈合，李桃没有理会突然的袭击，依旧高呼呐喊，参与着狂欢。确定李桃真的不会反击后，面具人走到她身侧，伸出了右手。水笼！空气中的水汽迅速往他手掌前方聚集，形成了一颗水珠，十几秒后，水珠膨胀成巨大的水球，将李桃整个人包裹在里面。他右手维持着水笼，左手对着许牧招了招，示意许牧过来。许牧绕过那些狂热粉丝，尽力避开那些恶心的触手，沿着阶梯向下，来到面具人身旁。“她已经被我控制住，只要我不解除这个水笼，等待她的只有窒息而亡，你可以解除你的能力效果了。”面具人自信说道。“等等吧。”许牧平淡说道。“为什么？”面具人疑惑问道。许牧眼眸微抬，看向舞台中心，无奈道：“因为我解除不了，只能等效果自动失效。”“……”水笼中的李桃张着嘴，却只能发出“咕噜咕噜”的气泡声，乳白触手开始慢慢回缩体内，隆起的肚子也在慢慢变小。看到这一幕，面具人解释道：“窒息开始了，她正在消耗灵性发动‘生命序列’的能力来对抗窒息，不久后，她的灵性就会耗尽。”十几分钟后，李桃的肚子恢复到正常状态，这表明她的灵性已经耗尽，此刻维持生命的，是执念之触。又过了十几分钟，许牧发现李桃慢慢闭上了双眼，身体不再有任何动作。“她死掉了。”面具人右手一挥，水球炸开，化作水雾融于空气中。失去外力束缚，李桃身体自然倒地，毫无生命体征。死了？看来不易死亡不等于不会死亡……许牧霍然明悟。一瞬间，周围的环境开始摇曳，极速发生变化，那些狂热粉丝，临时舞台，以及舞台上的肖凡全部消失不见。整个体育场变得空空荡荡，只剩看台上的许牧、面具人还有死去的李桃。“现在我们可以解除这片空间，离开这里了。”面具人抬手按住脸上的面具，“回到现实后，带上你断掉的左手，来李桃家门口找我。”许牧看见对方的面具上微光荡漾，接着感觉自已一阵恍惚，眼前一切被黑暗笼罩。再次睁开眼，许牧看见了天花板，看见了熟悉的房间，这是他的卧室。原来那件超凡物品就是他的面具……许牧回想起在集体潜意识空间的最后一幕，以及面具人最后一句话。断掉的左手……许牧坐起来，看见半只手掌正在床上静静安放，周围布满一大片血迹。还真是奇诡啊……他捡起那半只手掌，离开卧室，来到玄关，推开防盗门，看见了对面门口的熟悉身影。面具人回头望了过来，发现是许牧后，呵呵笑道：“怪不得你被拉进了集体潜意识空间，原来你就住对门。”许牧关好房门，催促道：“先办正事，我等着修手呢。”“等着，我去里面开门。”说完，面具人哗啦一声化成一滩液体，顺着门缝钻进了401。没多久，401的防盗门从里面打开，许牧蹑手蹑脚地走了进去。两人用同样的流程进入李桃的卧室，看到她躺在床上失去了气息。一条类似触手的事物正安静置于她的小腹位置。“你运气不错，她的超凡灵性已经凝聚成遗留物了。”面具人轻声道，以免吵醒主卧熟睡的李桃父母。这时，许牧看到自已脑海中的面板发生了变化。【检测到‘生命序列’超凡灵性，是否吸收】【超凡灵性总上限：3/9】他没有选择吸收，一是不能在外人面前暴露金手指，二是他之前已经做好打算，先了解各个序列的能力后再有选择性的吸收。许牧用下巴指了指李桃小腹上的遗留物，示意面具人搞快点。面具人弯腰拿起那条触手般的纤细事物，转而小声说道：“把你的断手拼到伤口上面。”许牧没有废话，按照提示照做。面具人将那条遗留物放在许牧左手背上，然后蔓延出自已的灵性。在灵性的催动下，那条遗留物仿佛活了过来，它像缝合针一样，在许牧左手的伤口处钻进钻出。这个过程，许牧没有感觉到疼痛，左手反而有种伤口愈合前的瘙痒。很快，那条小东西就将许牧的断掌缝合到了一起，完好如同最初，一点疤痕也没留下。许牧控制左手握拳，张开，再握拳，再张开，感受一番后，觉得和以前毫无差别。
content_en: Just now, the masked man woke up and found himself lying in the green belt. He knew who saved him without even thinking.He unintentionally involved others, but unexpectedly they became the key factor in his survival.This made him feel ashamed and grateful at the same time, and he felt like he was losing face.So after he woke up, he immediately returned to room 401 upstairs, picked up his backpack, and chased after him following the traces of the fight.The masked man suddenly stopped in front of Xu Mu, glanced at the embarrassed Xu Mu, he pulled the brim of his hat in embarrassment and said: "I was careless, I didn't expect this out-of-control person to be so strong, I'm sorry." Immediately, his exposed eyes suddenly widened, pointing to Xu Mu's left hand, and blurted out: "I'll go.!How did you get yourself into this?" In the masked man's understanding, Xu Mu was able to withstand the scream that made him unconscious, and rescued himself. He was also able to fight the monster girl one-on-one, and he thought that Xu Mu's strength should not be inferior to his own, and he would not lose his limbs no matter what.You still have the nerve to ask, I can be whole now... No, it's good to be able to stand here alive... Xu Mu rolled his eyes at the masked man, and with a trembling voice to endure the severe pain, he said angrily: "Stop talking, use your extraordinary items to clear this space..." "Not yet.If this space is released now, Li Tao, that girl, will appear in reality as a monster." The masked man took off the backpack on his shoulders and opened the zipper. "And you will also bring the severed hand back to reality." "Treat the wound first." He took out a bottle of dark red liquid from his backpack and handed it to Xu Mu, "Pour this on the wound to stop the bleeding quickly.Then we will deal with Li Tao." Xu Mu took the bottle and said with a pale face: "Li Tao is affected by my ability. She is not attacking now.The desire to attack and kill will not harm anyone if it appears in reality.It can be handled by Bureau 749. "Of course, this will definitely cause panic. As for how to calm the panic and block the news, it is 749's business... Xu Mu added silently in his heart."But in this case, her extraordinary relics will be taken away by Bureau 749." The masked man put on his backpack again and looked at Xu Mu, "The special thing in Li Tao's body can restore your left hand. Are you sure you want to give up this opportunity?" "Extraordinary relics? What is that?" Because of his physical weakness and lack of energy, Xu Mu was stunned and blurted out the words in his heart.The masked man's eyes were surprised, and then he realized: "You don't know this? You just became a transcendent not long ago." Xu Mu remained silent, feeling a little annoyed that he had accidentally exposed the truth."After extraordinary creatures die, their extraordinary spirituality will gradually condense together to form remnants." The masked man explained to himself, "These remnants can be used to prepare magic potions, make spells or extraordinary items." Then he changed the topic and said as if to show off his knowledge: "But this is not absolute. Sometimes, extraordinary spirituality does not condense, but escapes, and cannot be collected without special means." Xu Mu stood aside and listened calmly, and at the same time, he also thought about some details.It turned out that Lu Jianxing and the others were checking the surveillance system at the funeral home, and one of their important purposes was to find An Lin's extraordinary relics.It's just that those extraordinary spirits were absorbed by me, making Lu Jianxing and Feng Huajin mistakenly think that they had escaped.No wonder they looked a little disappointed at that time.etc!The masked man's goal is to kill Li Tao and obtain the extraordinary relics. Could An Lin's death also be his work?Thinking of this, Xu Mu asked carefully: "Have you been hunting these contaminated out-of-control people recently?" The masked man did not shy away and answered calmly: "Yes, we just solved one two days ago. The same woman, the same weird belly, and the same Xiao Fan'sFan, her name is An Lin.I took away An Lin's extraordinary relics and found that they belong to the "life sequence" and have strong regeneration capabilities, so I dare to conclude that Li Tao also belongs to this sequence, so your hand can still be saved." Hearing this, Xu Mu frowned.This is not right. If you took away An Lin's extraordinary relics, how come she still has extra extraordinary spirituality for me to absorb?Moreover, An Lin’s extraordinary spirituality is clearly a ‘spiritual sequence’.Suddenly, Xu Mu thought of a possibility.That is, after An Lin died, she became a corpse and was once again contaminated by some factors with the extraordinary spirituality of the 'spiritual sequence'."Then how are you sure that after Li Tao's death, her extraordinary spirituality will be condensed, in case it escapes..." Xu Mu raised half of his bloody left hand, "Do you have a way to collect her extraordinary spirituality and help me restore my left hand?" "No." The masked man answered truthfully."If that happens, I will apply to my organization to use An Lin's extraordinary relics afterwards." He raised his hand to hold down the mask and considered, "But that will take time. I can't guarantee how well your hand will recover by then." Sure enough, it's still unreliable... Xu Mu cursed, but now he really has no other way to treat the injury on his left hand.Xu Mu sighed secretly and compromised: "Okay, but agree in advance that I am not good at killing, and you will be responsible for dealing with Li Tao later." The masked man raised his hand and made an OK gesture, and said nonchalantly: "No problem." After saying that, he stretched out his thumb and index finger, made a pistol gesture, and pointed at a pickup truck next to him.water gun!Water mist condensed on his fingertips, and a thin, sharp, high-pressure water column shot out, penetrating the pickup truck door and destroying the door lock.The masked man opened the door and got into the driver's seat first.He started the vehicle through wiring, turned to Xu Mu and said, "Get in the car!" Damn it!When you first had this ability, you killed Li Tao with one shot. Now that you're showing off, I really want to punch you twice... Xu Mu secretly complained and got into the passenger seat. Before he could even close the door, the vehicle suddenly started and sped out in an instant.Ten minutes later, in front of the largest open-air stadium in Qingteng City, the pickup truck drifted to a stop.The masked man and Xu Mu opened the car door at the same time and walked out.Above the stadium, laser light poles of different colors move and shine according to the rhythm of the music.The venue was noisy, with screams and shouts coming and going.Several uniformed security personnel guarded the entrance to the stadium."This should be the concert where Li Tao's subconscious manifested." The masked man glanced at the lights above the stadium.The subconscious space is really convenient... Xu Mu was amazed. He just pointed in a random direction, and Li Tao realized the scene and people in a reasonable way.The masked man walked straight towards the entrance, with Xu Mu following closely behind, while the security personnel ignored him and did not stop him in any way."These people are all embodied by Li Tao's subconscious. You can only interact with Li Tao and don't care about them." The masked man explained casually.The two of them walked into the front hall, went up to the sixth floor, passed through a passage, and came to the uppermost stand in the stadium.A temporary stage was set up in the center of the football field below. In the center of the stage, a figure was dancing an unsightly dance.Xu Mu guessed that the person should be Xiao Fan, but it was a pity that it was Li Tao who appeared, otherwise he really wanted to encourage the masked man to go over and kill him.Looking back, Xu Mu planned to look for Li Tao in the audience, but what he saw next made him take a breath.There were nearly a thousand people sitting in the terraced stands, and without exception they were all women. Their bellies were all swollen, and milky-white tentacles emerged from them, crawling and tumbling all over the auditorium.Those fans shouted wildly, their expressions were distorted, they tore their hair, scratched their faces, and some pulled out the tentacles on their stomachs and swung them wildly.Xu Mu took a step back and took a deep breath.If this scene was realized by Li Tao based on real-life experience, it means that in reality, there are nearly a thousand contaminated girls hidden in Qingteng City.If they break out at the same time, the consequences...what does Xiao Fan want to do?"I saw her. As agreed, I will take care of it while you wait here." The masked man patted Xu Mu on the shoulder.Xu Mu put away his thoughts, nodded, and reminded: "Although she will not fight back due to the influence of my ability, she is not easy to die. In addition, she is a 'life sequence', and her vitality will be more tenacious. You have to exert some strength and accumulate as much damage as possible. When the effect of my ability ends, the damage will be enough to kill her instantly." "Your ability is quite interesting." The masked man smiled humorously, then bent his knees and arched his back, jumping to the stands diagonally below.He came to a position more than ten meters away from Li Tao, raised his hand and fired two water guns. The water column passed through his head and heart, making Li Tao stagger two steps.The wound healed quickly. Li Tao ignored the sudden attack and still shouted and participated in the carnival.After confirming that Li Tao really wouldn't fight back, the masked man walked to her side and stretched out his right hand.Water cage!The water vapor in the air quickly gathered in front of his palm, forming a water droplet.
